remove_title: Its {count} micro-frontends are dropped with it
remove_confirm: Remove the product's frontend, with the micro-frontends picked for it?
reading_has: Reading whether the product has a frontend…
none_lead: No frontend: the product is its gears and their APIs, which is a whole product. Add one when it needs screens: a FrontX shell from
sync_still_running: The sync is still running; come back to this tab when it is done.
reading_catalogue: Reading the micro-frontends in the catalogue…
save_unknown: The catalogue does not list {names}; sync the catalogue, then save.
save_bad_shell: The shell `{shell}` is not a repository and directory.
save_unplaced: The catalogue does not say where {names} is yet; sync the catalogue, then save.
gears_missing: Gears the screens call that are not in the product: {count}
unknown_picks: The catalogue does not list {names}, so they are not on the page. Sync the catalogue to bring them back, or drop them before saving.
gdl_note_kept: Kept with the product. Its product.gdl says it as frontend = frontx_product(...) from the next revision: step 2 above, Save to product.gdl, shows the block and saves it.
gdl_note_before: Picked before the product kept its frontend, so product.gdl does not say it yet. Save to the product, then step 2 above, Save to product.gdl, writes frontend = frontx_product(...).
no_mfe_calls: no micro-frontend in the catalogue calls it
find_placeholder: What should it show? people, specs…
none_to_add: No micro-frontend to add yet: they come from a repository the catalogue reads as frontx, one package with an mfe.json under src-app/mfe_packages/ each.
read_own: Read this project's own repository: its micro-frontends land here with their screens.
add_repository: Add a repository with micro-frontends under Components › Repositories, mode frontx, and sync.
templates: Start a new micro-frontend from a template
templates_how: Copy a template into your repository's src-app/mfe_packages/, give it its screens, and sync: it lands above as one to add.
templates_which: : a blank one, a demo, two widgets.
drag_here: Drag a micro-frontend here, or press Add.
no_shot: No screenshot of this screen yet
pp_api_title: The path its screens call the backend under, proxied to the API Gateway
declared_title: The package states this in its frontx.gdl
guessed_title: The package has no frontx.gdl that reads; the scan inferred this from its files
inspector_empty: Pick a screen or a micro-frontend to see where it shows and which gears it calls: ✓ the product has the gear, ✗ add it under Backend.
names_none: Its API services name no /cf/<gear>/v route.
add_missing: Add {gears} under Backend, or this screen has nothing to talk to.
read_from: Read from the base URLs of its API services and of the FrontX packages it depends on; {count} gears are in the product.
roles_none: None: its frontx.gdl lists no role.
cmd_packages: the FrontX packages the shell carries
cmd_manifests: what the shell reads to mount them
fit_unread: Not read yet: sync the catalogue to see the versions it asks for.
fit_no_shell: The shell is not in the catalogue, so what it carries is unknown.
fit_differs: The shell carries other versions; the build gets the shell's. It builds only if the package uses nothing they lack: try a shell its versions match.
